﻿1. Road Segment Selection

Click on the desired road segment within the map to highlight the road feature for further editing. To select more than (1) road segment for batch editing, use the Select tool from the widget menu above. Choose your desired Select by option and highlight all road segments you'd like to edit at once.
2. Updating RSR After Treatment

With the desired road segments selected, navigate to the Edit tool from the widget menu above. Update the Current RSR score to the new RSR value after treatment. This will automatically adjust the Repair Methodology. From there, update the Treatment Date and Treatment Type accordingly. Click Update at the bottom of the Edit tool to save your changes.

config.text: ﻿1. Road Segment Selection

Click on the desired road segment within the map to highlight the road feature for further editing. To select more than (1) road segment for batch editing, use the Select tool from the widget menu above. Choose your desired Select by option and highlight all road segments you'd like to edit at once.

With the desired road segments selected, navigate to the Edit tool within the widget menu above. Update each of the fields as necessary. Note: Updating the Projected RSR along with the planned Treatment Year will update the Projected RSR gauge accordingly. Any cost updates will be reflected in the bar chart. Tip: clicking on each of the bars will filter both the chart and map by the planned Treatment Year.
﻿2. Update CIP Information For Roads
﻿3. Generate Plan Report

Updates made to the Treatment Year, various cost fields, and Funding Source can be compiled into a report for estimating purposes. Once you have made your edits to your desired roads, click the button below to download your own plan summary or navigate to the CIP Report tool within the widget menu above.
